sentences.en: Then they played "ring-a-ring-a-rosy" until they were tired and thirsty.
sentences.zh: 然后他们玩‘环形花环’直到又累又渴。

sentences.en: I am thirsty. Please give me something cold to drink.
Give water to the thirsty and food to the hungry.
sentences.zh: 给口渴的人水，给饥饿的人食物。

senses.zh: 渴望的, 渴求的; 渴的, 口渴的; 干旱的, 缺水的; 耗油的
